description: This file defines the feature for creating a new article within the Conduit project. It includes data models, validation logic, command handling, and database interactions related to article creation.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: DTO encapsulating the data required to create an article, including title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring non-null and non-empty values for article data fields.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Command object representing the request to create a new article, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for the Command object, reusing the ArticleDataValidator for its Article property.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a new article, performing database operations including author retrieval, tag handling, and saving the article.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes the create article command, manages database transactions, and returns the created article envelope.
